title: Verificar com gov.br (trust step 5)
summary: A person verifies the name with a gov.br signature (bipe-chat/bipe#544, ADR 0019). Two numbered buttons in sequence, always on the screen (MZ, 3 November 2026, bipe-chat/bipe#1007): 1 bipe_govbr_download gets a challenge PDF from the API, saves it on the phone and opens the gov.br app; the user signs there; 2 bipe_govbr_upload sends the signed file, which Bipe uploads and checks. The user types nothing.

phase.description: The phases of BipeGovbrFlow. ready: both buttons; download is on, upload is off. preparing: POST /v1/verifications/govbr runs; download shows progress. waitingForSignature: the PDF is saved and the gov.br app is open; both buttons are on. checking: PUT .../document runs, bipe_govbr_checking replaces the buttons. verified: bipe_govbr_verified with the name and bipe_app_close. rejected: the reason string above both buttons; download is on, upload is off. failed: bipe_error_generic above both buttons, as rejected.

reason.description: rejected only. VerificationStatus.reason (not_signed, not_govbr, wrong_document, expired, cpf_in_use, changed_after_signing), shown as bipe_govbr_reason_<reason>. A rejection without a reason, and the state expired, is expired.

verifiedName.description: verified only. The name in the new badge payload, read without the signature check: only for the owner's own screen. Absent: bipe_govbr_verified_no_name.

download.effect: bipe_govbr_download, button 1. In waitingForSignature it saves the same challenge PDF again and opens the gov.br app; it makes no new challenge. In every other phase it runs POST /v1/verifications/govbr first. The challenge PDF (GovbrChallenge.pdf, file name GovbrChallenge.fileName) goes to the phone: iOS through the system save dialog, Android to Downloads with MediaStore. Then the gov.br app opens: iOS its App Store page (iosStoreUrl), Android the app by androidPackage when installed, else androidStoreUrl with bipe_govbr_get_app.

receiveDocument.effect: A PDF reaches Bipe from the share sheet or open with (iOS CFBundleDocumentTypes and onOpenURL; Android ACTION_SEND and ACTION_VIEW of application/pdf). The rule govbrIncoming (test-vectors/govbr-verify.json) decides: upload goes to PUT /v1/verifications/govbr/{verificationId}/document at once and shows checking; noOpenVerification shows bipe_govbr_no_open_verification and uploads nothing; ignore drops it; notSigned shows the reason not_signed.

upload.effect: bipe_govbr_upload, button 2, under button 1 and never in its place. On only in waitingForSignature. A PDF picker (iOS UIDocumentPickerViewController for .pdf, Android ActivityResultContracts.OpenDocument for application/pdf). The picked file follows receiveDocument.

close.effect: Closes the screen. After verified, trust-card and trust-profile rebuild and step 5 shows done.

notes: The only entry is the step 5 row of trust-profile, on a personal account. Bipe never offers this flow from a chat, a link or a notification (bipe-chat/bipe#277), and bipe_govbr_safety says so on the screen.

Build flag govbrEnabled (iOS AppConfig.govbrEnabled, Android BuildConfig.BIPE_GOVBR): iOS: on in debug builds of the tester ID set and in TestFlight installs, off in App Store installs until bipe-chat/bipe#17 (legal review) closes; Android: on in every build outside the store ID set. A build value, never a stored or remote one (bipe-app tools/release-gate.mjs). Flag off: step 5 shows bipe_trust_coming_soon, the row opens nothing and an incoming PDF is not handled.

Layout: navigation title bipe_govbr_title; bipe_govbr_intro; the three lines bipe_govbr_step_save, bipe_govbr_step_sign, bipe_govbr_step_share; bipe_govbr_needs_level; bipe_govbr_safety; then the phase line and the two numbered buttons, download above upload.
The API has no answer for a gov.br account below silver: bipe_govbr_needs_level is a fixed line on the screen, not a result.
The server makes the PDF and reads the name and the CPF from the signature. The app never makes a PDF, never shows a CPF and keeps no copy of the signed file after the upload.
The flow lives in memory. When the app stops between the save and the share, the next PDF shows noOpenVerification; start makes a new challenge.
Web: none. Web has no trust ladder step.
